decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered 100, 200, 300, 400 and Design & Access Statement Received 22/12/2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - All equipment hereby permitted shall be removed from the building known as Rex House as soon as reasonably practicable after it is no longer required for telecommunications purposes and such building shall be restored to its condition before the development took place.
description: Addition of 3 no. rooftop radio antenna at Rex House located on new stand-off brackets attached to the existing vodafone pole mounts on the plant room and the addition of associated electronics equipment within the existing vodafone cabin
